This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Native iOS application (SwiftUI) for Hotlympics face rating: users rate face images, view leaderboards, upload photos, manage profile via tabbed UI.

open ios-app.xcodeproj  
xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build  
xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'  
xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj  

**Bundle ID**: hotlympics.ios-app  
**Preferred Simulator**: iPhone 16 Pro  
**Dependencies**: Firebase Auth, Firebase Storage, Google Sign-In (via Swift Package Manager)  
After making changes, build the project and fix any warnings or errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator.

**Main Entry**: `App/ios_appApp.swift` — Configures Firebase; handles URL schemes for Google Sign-In.  

**Navigation**: Tab-based UI with five main sections:  
- Rating (flame icon) — Image pair rating interface with swipe gestures (unrestricted)  
- Leaderboard (trophy icon) — Top-rated images display with Glicko-2 scores (unrestricted)  
- Upload (plus icon) — Photo upload with cropping (requires authentication and complete profile)  
- My Photos (photo stack icon) — User uploaded photos and pool management (requires authentication and complete profile)  
- Profile (person icon) — User authentication/account management (requires authentication and complete profile)

**auth/FirebaseAuthService**: Firebase authentication + Google Sign-In; Google OAuth flow with GIDSignIn SDK; token management & automatic session restoration; backend profile sync on auth changes; profile update methods for gender/DOB and Terms of Service acceptance; tracks current user with profile completion status.

**data/ImageQueueService**: dual-block image queue for seamless rating flow; maintains active/buffer blocks (10 images each); pre-fetches next block; gender-based filtering (shows opposite gender to authenticated user); automatic queue reset on authentication changes.

**api/RatingService**: rating submissions to backend API.  
**data/ImagePreloader**: NSCache-based image caching/50-image limit across views; clears on memory pressure.  
**api/UploadService**: requests signed upload URL; uploads compressed images to Firebase Storage; tracks progress via URLSession delegation; confirms backend success.  
**data/UserService**: manages user photos/pool selections; smart caching (5-minute validity); preloads images; forces refresh after pool updates/photo uploads; optimistic deletion with rollback; removes deleted photos from pool.

UI/feature structure:  
**Rating/**: SwipeCardView (swipe + velocity + spring animations), ImagePairView (dual display + tap), SwipeIndicatorView, ImageElementView (loading states).  
**Upload/**: UploadView (source selection), PhotoSourcePickerView (camera/gallery), CameraView (UIImagePickerController wrapper), UploadProgressView, ImageCropperView (custom 400x400 crop, pinch/pan), ImageCropperViewController (confirm).  
**Photos/**: MyPhotosView (grid + pool selection, max 2), PhotoGridView, PhotoCellView (selection state), PoolSelectionBarView, EmptyPhotosView.  
**Auth/**: SignInView (email/password + Google Sign-In), SignInPromptView (protected features prompt), ProfileSetupView (sequential completion), GenderDOBSetupView, TermsOfServiceView.  
**shared/**: CachedAsyncImageView.  

**MyPhotosViewModel**: manages photo grid + pool selections; optimistic deletions; max 2 validation; success message management.  
**UploadViewModel**: upload workflow state; image processing/compression; progress tracking; error handling + retry.
